rules.sentence: When `WS-FEE-STATUS` is not `'00'`, it opens `FEE-SCHEDULE` for input and `FEE-TABLE` for output; and stops the run.

When `WS-FEE-STATUS` is `'00'`, it opens `FEE-SCHEDULE` for input and `FEE-TABLE` for output; repeats its loop until `WS-AT-END` is `'Y'` (`SCHEDULE-AT-END`); closes `FEE-SCHEDULE` and `FEE-TABLE`; and stops the run.
When reading `FEE-SCHEDULE` finds no more records, it reads `FEE-SCHEDULE` and sets `WS-AT-END` to `SCHEDULE-AT-END`.
When reading `FEE-SCHEDULE` finds a record, it reads `FEE-SCHEDULE` and performs `LOAD-FEE`.

actions: CALL 'feeslot' USING FD-PRODUCT FD-REGION FD-GROUP RETURNING WS-SLOT

rules.sentence: When `WS-SLOT` is zero, it calls `FEESLOT`, sets `WS-RESULT` to 8, and leaves the section.

When `WS-SLOT` is not zero and writing `FEE-SLOT-RECORD` fails on its key, it calls `FEESLOT`, sets `FS-RATE` to `FD-RATE`, sets `FS-FIXED-CENTS` to `FD-FIXED`, writes `FEE-SLOT-RECORD`, and sets `WS-RESULT` to 8.
When `WS-SLOT` is not zero and writing `FEE-SLOT-RECORD` succeeds by its key, it calls `FEESLOT`, sets `FS-RATE` to `FD-RATE`, sets `FS-FIXED-CENTS` to `FD-FIXED`, and writes `FEE-SLOT-RECORD`.
